name: Whirlpool ACU Top-Load Dryer Element (Single)
purpose: Single heating element ~10 Ω from thermal cut-off red to heater red (W11416805 ACU top-load).
failureModes: Short to ground — heat won't shut off
testingTips: Measure red wire at thermal cut-off to red wire at heater element
Not CCU dual-element ≤50 Ω — WED51* uses single ~10 Ω path

name: Whirlpool ACU Top-Load Dryer Steam/Water Valve
purpose: Steam/water valve coil resistance ACU J8-1 (red) to J9-2 (L1) — TEST #9 on steam-capable models.
failureModes: Open — no steam/water spray during cycle
Out of range — replace water valve assembly
testingTips: Power off before measuring at ACU connector
Verify water supply on before condemning valve
